newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes seven cents down to 14.48 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes seven cents down to 14.48 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell seven cents to close at 14.48 ringgit ($5.83) on a technical correction, traders said.
There were few factors to inspire players, who chose to ignore the overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange.

"Buyers were only coming in at lower levels...it was a technical correction," said a trader. There were initial bids for 96 tonnes against offers for 121. Final turnover was 93 tonnes, against 120 on Wednesday, and was absorbed by European and local interests. A $20 discount was retained against London.
